data.name: Heistline
data.detailed_description:
Step into a dynamic open-world experience where you choose your fate—will you uphold the law or break it? In The Prisonbreak, you can either serve as a police officer, hunting down criminals and restoring order, or embrace the life of crime, escaping from prison, running heists, and building your own criminal empire.

Choose Your Side

🔹 Play as a Police Officer:

  • Keep criminals locked up and prevent escapes.

  • Chase down fugitives and bring them back to justice.

  • Protect the city from organized crime and dismantle enemy bases.

  • Earn bounties for capturing high-profile criminals.

🔹 Play as a Criminal:

  • Escape from prison using tools, weapons, or bribery.

  • Rob stores, banks, and other locations to amass wealth.

  • Take down cops before they catch you.

  • Build your own gang and establish a secure base.

Key Features

⭐ Online Multiplayer – Team up with friends or go solo in this action-packed world.
⭐ Base Building – Construct a personal home or a high-security criminal hideout.
⭐ Bounty System – Earn rewards for taking down high-profile criminals.
⭐ Heists & Robberies – Plan tactical break-ins and increase your fortune.
⭐ Reputation System – Good behavior is rewarded, while rule-breakers face consequences.

Will you be the enforcer of justice or the mastermind of crime? The choice is yours.

🔥 Wishlist now and prepare for the ultimate battle between law and chaos! 🔥

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7500 / AMD Ryzen 5 1400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (6GB) / AMD Radeon RX 580 (8GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-kompatible Soundkarte
  • Additional Notes: Niedrige bis mittlere Einstellungen, 1080p, 30-60 FPS
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-kompatible Soundkarte mit 7.1 Unterstützung
  • Additional Notes: Hohe Einstellungen, 1440p, 60+ FPS

content_descriptors.notes: This game features intense gun violence. Players engage in combat using various firearms, either as law enforcement stopping crime or as criminals on the run. There are no explicit depictions of sexual content or other sensitive themes.
